title: Payroll periods & runs
intro: Close labor into payroll periods, generate runs with previews, and post adjustments.

sections.title: Payroll periods
steps: Create periods matching your pay cycle (weekly, biweekly, monthly, custom).
Lock or close periods before final runs.
sections.caption: Payroll periods list.

sections.title: Payroll period form
steps: Add a period with name, type, and date range.
Leave status Open while collecting time and adjustments.
Change to Locked/Closed/Paid as the cycle progresses.
sections.caption: Payroll period form.

fields.name: Period name
fields.effect: Label shown on runs and payslip exports.

fields.name: Period type
fields.effect: Weekly, biweekly, monthly, or custom cadence.

fields.name: Start date
fields.effect: First day included in the period.

fields.name: End date
fields.effect: Last day included in the period.

fields.name: Status
fields.effect: Open allows edits; locked/closed restrict changes; paid marks completion.

sections.title: Payroll runs
steps: Open Payroll → Runs for an open period.
Generate a run to preview gross pay from attendance and rules.
Review snapshots before marking the run complete.
sections.caption: Payroll runs for a period.

sections.title: Generate payroll run
steps: Click New run and select an open payroll period.
Generate preview to calculate lines from time, profiles, and rules.
sections.caption: New payroll run form.

fields.name: Payroll period
fields.effect: Date range and status governing which hours and adjustments are included.

fields.name: Run number
fields.effect: Sequential identifier for multiple previews within the same period.

sections.title: Payroll adjustments
steps: Add bonuses, penalties, allowances, or corrections per employee.
Link to a payroll period when the amount should appear on a run.
sections.caption: Labor adjustments list.

sections.title: Adjustment form
steps: Choose employee, type, amount, and effective date.
Optionally tie to a payroll period.
Save — included on the next run covering that date.
sections.caption: Payroll adjustment form.

fields.name: Payroll period
fields.effect: Optional link so the amount rolls into a specific run.

fields.name: Type
fields.effect: Bonus, penalty, allowance, reimbursement, advance, loan, correction, or deduction.

fields.name: Amount
fields.effect: Currency value added or subtracted from gross pay.

fields.name: Effective date
fields.effect: Date used to determine which run picks up the adjustment.

fields.name: Description
fields.effect: Explanation on payslip detail and audit trail.
